in_sanskrit.name: तपिश्वर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who holds fire in his heart and mind, or the one who is the lord of the Agni, the god of fire.

in_tamil.name: தபிஷ்வர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who holds the fire within him.

in_marathi.name: Tapishwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tapishwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Tapishwar is a powerful Hindu name derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound name, composed of the prefix 'Tapi' and the suffix 'ishwar'. 'Tapi' means 'strong' and 'ishwar' means 'god'. Thus, Tapishwar can be translated as 'God of Power'.

in_bengali.name: Tapishwar

It is a compound name, composed of the prefix 'Tapi' and the suffix 'ishwar'. 'Tapi' means 'strong' and 'ishwar' means 'god'. Thus, Tapishwar can be translated as 'God of Power'.
